Fig. 1[4] also links the thinner film to a different ALD cycle count. The potential shifts did not differ meaningfully between the films: both showed shifts of about ∼40 mV[5], and similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[6] for the thicknesses, which the authors attribute to their similar locked-in elastic strains.
